# Curriculum + Segmentation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`).

**Goal:** Turn the tutor's knowledge + a student profile into an **editable curriculum tree** (Modules→Lessons→Segments) generated by the LLM and grounded in the Brain, plus an **auto+manual segmentation** engine (a big "25-hour course" → teachable sessions), surfaced in a real **cockpit** (nav rail + Students + Curricula card board).

**Architecture:** A `app/curriculum/` package (generate, segment) on the Foundations `Block` tree + a new `guided_json` provider method; new `Student`/`Assignment`/`Progress`/`LessonLog` persistence; a `routers/curriculum.py` + `routers/students.py`; and a Next.js cockpit shell (`AppShell` nav) with a **Students** page and a **Curricula** card board (nested, editable, generate/segment actions).

**Tech Stack:** FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, pgvector (retrieval reuse), the `QwenVLLM` provider (+ `guided_json` via vLLM `response_format`), Next.js/React/shadcn, next-intl.

## Global Constraints (verbatim)

- **Everything curricular is a `Block`** (Foundations `app/models/block.py`): `id, parent_id (self-FK, cascade), order, kind (soft: course/module/lesson/session/topic), title, body, est_minutes, language, is_template`. Nest to any depth. A **Curriculum = a root Block** (`is_template=True` for library templates; a personalized instance is a deep-clone assigned to a student).
- **Two planes:** Content (the authored tree) vs Delivery (Session blocks produced by *segmenting* content for a student's session length/cadence). Segmentation is a projection — author once, render many.
- **Structured LLM output via `guided_json`** (vLLM `response_format={"type":"json_schema",...}` — constrains decoding, never parse malformed JSON). Add it to the `LLMProvider` ABC + `QwenVLLM`. Grounding: retrieve Brain context with `app.brain.retrieve.search(...)` and put it in the prompt; keep the system prompt tool-first/imperative and facts-out (per `vllm_interract` gotchas).
- **Bilingual:** every generated Block carries `language`; generate in the profile's language; UI GR/EN via next-intl (add keys to both `en.json`/`el.json`).
- **Consume, don't re-implement:** `get_provider()` (chat/embed/health/**guided_json**); `app.brain.retrieve.search`; `app.db` (`Base/engine/SessionLocal/get_db`); `app.models.{block,student}`. Host tests: `DATABASE_URL=…localhost:5434… LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:6888/v1 EMBED_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8090/v1`, `apps/api/.venv/bin/{pytest,alembic}`.
- **Test isolation (do FIRST, Task 1):** integration tests must stop polluting the app `guitar` DB. Use a dedicated `guitar_test` DB via a `conftest.py` that points the engine at it + truncates between tests.
- **Web dev/test server:** Playwright config uses **port 3100** (`reuseExistingServer:false`); free with `fuser -k 3100/tcp` if stale; never bare `npm run dev` on 3000 (other apps live there).

## Task 2: `guided_json` provider + curriculum generation

**Files:** `app/llm/{base,qwen}.py` (+guided_json); `app/curriculum/generate.py`; tests.

**Interfaces produced:**
- `LLMProvider.guided_json(messages: list[dict], schema: dict, *, temperature=0.2) -> dict` (ABC + QwenVLLM impl via `response_format` json_schema).
- `generate_curriculum(db, *, title, language, profile: dict, domain: str | None, target_minutes_total: int | None) -> uuid` — retrieves Brain context (`search(db, <profile+domain query>, k=12, domain=domain)`), prompts the LLM with a **guided-JSON schema** for a nested tree (`{title, modules:[{title, objective, lessons:[{title, objectives:[str], est_minutes, segments:[{kind, title, body, est_minutes}]}]}]}`), and persists it as a `Block` tree (root `kind="course", is_template=True, language`). Returns the root Block id.

- [ ] **Step 1 (unit):** `guided_json` returns a dict matching a tiny schema (integration, live LLM) — e.g. schema `{type:object, properties:{answer:{type:string}}, required:[answer]}` → `"answer"` key present. RED→GREEN.
- [ ] **Step 2 (integration):** seed a Brain source about guitar tone (reuse ingest), `generate_curriculum(profile={"level":"intermediate"}, domain="tone", target_minutes_total=1500)` → assert a root Block exists with ≥2 module children, each with ≥1 lesson child, lessons have `est_minutes>0`, language propagated, and at least one segment references tone concepts (e.g. a title/body containing "amp"/"pedal"/"pickup"). Mark integration. RED→GREEN. Keep the tree persist logic recursive + simple.
- [ ] **Step 3:** commit.

## Task 3: Segmentation engine

**Files:** `app/curriculum/segment.py`; tests.

**Interfaces produced:** `segment_block(db, block_id, *, session_minutes: int, cadence_per_week: int = 1, student_id: uuid | None = None) -> list[uuid]` — reads the content subtree under `block_id`, uses `guided_json` (constraints: don't split a concept mid-way; review at module seams; total ≈ sum of leaf est_minutes) to produce an ordered list of **session** specs each ~`session_minutes`, and persists them as `Block(kind="session", plane="delivery", parent_id=<a delivery root under the course>, order=i, est_minutes≈session_minutes)` with a `body` summarizing what that session covers (referencing the source content blocks). Returns the session block ids in order.

- [ ] **Step 1 (integration):** on the Task-2 generated course (say ~1500 min total), `segment_block(session_minutes=50)` → assert ~25–35 sessions returned, in order, each `est_minutes` within [~30, ~70], `plane="delivery"`, and their summed minutes ≈ the content total (±20%). Also a manual re-segment with `session_minutes=120` → fewer, longer sessions. RED→GREEN.
- [ ] **Step 2:** a pure unit test for the pacing helper (given leaf durations + target, the partition logic yields the right session count/bounds) — no model. Commit.

## Task 4: Curriculum + Students API

**Files:** `app/routers/{curriculum,students}.py`; `app/schemas/{curriculum,students}.py`; wire in `main.py`.

**Interfaces produced (routes):**
- Students: `POST /students`, `GET /students`, `GET /students/{id}`, `PATCH /students/{id}`, `DELETE /students/{id}`.
- Curriculum: `GET /curricula` (templates list), `POST /curricula/generate` (body: title,language,profile,domain?,target_minutes_total? → runs `generate_curriculum`, returns root id + tree), `GET /curricula/{root_id}` (returns the nested tree), `GET /blocks/{id}` , `PATCH /blocks/{id}` (title/body/est_minutes/order), `POST /blocks/{id}/segment` (session_minutes,cadence? → `segment_block`), `POST /curricula/{root_id}/assign` (student_id → deep-clone the template as an assigned instance for the student, returns new root id), `DELETE /blocks/{id}`.
- A `block_to_tree(block) -> dict` serializer (recursive: id,kind,title,body,est_minutes,order,language,plane,children[]).

- [ ] **Step 1 (integration):** via `TestClient`: create a student; `POST /curricula/generate` (tone, intermediate) → tree returned; `PATCH` a lesson's title → persisted; `POST /blocks/{root}/segment` → sessions; `POST /curricula/{root}/assign` with the student → a new instance root distinct from the template, with the same structure but `student_id` set and `is_template=False`. Assert each. (Generation/segment tests reuse the live LLM → mark integration; CRUD/serialize/assign are fast.) RED→GREEN.
- [ ] **Step 2:** commit.
